title: Appealing an Infraction

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately we don't appeal warns in these scenarios. Warns are only meant to alert of what you are doing wrong before further punishments are issued, so it's not too much to worry about.

Regards,
Mango_
